items.note: It now reads `applyOps`, `scene` and `operands` only when the action declared them, with `in` checks. A dev deps proxy threw on `applyOps` before it ever reached `operands`.

items.claim: [r42-2] `moveEachOps` zero-delta entry doesn't claim its nodes (carried, A+B)
[r42-3] `enumerateAnchors` skips the implicit start of a subpath opened after `Z` (carried, A)
items.note: It now emits an `implicit: true` anchor, numbered as `pathToAnchors` numbers it. Its `coordIndex` is the closed subpath's opening `M`, or -1 when there is no coordinate.

items.claim: [r42-4] `translateAnchor` moves a one-segment quadratic loop's control twice (carried, A)
[r42-5] `swappable` lets a cross-parent swap land a node where `childVerdict` would refuse it (carried, B)
items.note: Under two parents, each parent must now take the other's node through `admitsChild`, which reads `canDropInto`. The `swap` action now declares `canDropInto`.

items.claim: [r42-6] `childVerdict` holds the follower page rule only for the page itself (carried, B)
items.note: It now uses `pageIdOf(parent)` for any container on a page.
